topic: Iterators and Range-based for loops for efficient data processing
explanation: Iterators provide a generic way to traverse elements in various container types (vectors, lists, maps, etc.) without needing to know the underlying implementation details.  Range-based for loops offer a more concise and readable way to iterate over containers, improving code maintainability and reducing errors.  This is a cornerstone of effective C++ programming, enhancing both efficiency and readability.
